title: Design System: Christian Raro, Portfolio 6.0 First Light

name.purpose: The homepage h1 beside the portrait (.text-name).

page-h1.purpose: The h1 of every inner page (.text-page-h1).

section.purpose: A section heading on /about, /hire and the form (.text-section); no eyebrow over it.

list.purpose: The heading of a homepage list or a /projects band, with its count (.text-list).

row.purpose: A row's name, a role, a place (.text-row).

lede.purpose: The headline sentence and page answers (.text-lede).

body.purpose: Prose; Arial size-adjusted to Instrument Sans is the fallback.

map-label.purpose: Place names on the maps and small labels (.map-label).

fonts.name: Arial (size-adjusted)
fonts.purpose: The fallback, sized to Instrument Sans's metrics so the swap re-wraps nothing.

shadows.name: shadow-lift
shadows.purpose: Only while a linked screenshot is lifted, on a pseudo-element faded in by opacity.

shadows.name: shadow-overlay
shadows.purpose: The panel and the bar, the dialog, chat, lightbox and toasts.

motion.name: dur-fast
motion.purpose: Hover, press, underline, a row pane fading.

motion.name: dur-normal
motion.purpose: The lozenge gliding, a row pane settling, view-transition groups, a disclosure opening.

motion.name: dur-slow
motion.purpose: Each rising line, a row thumbnail zooming, the map pan and the pins.

motion.name: stagger-line
motion.purpose: Between the three rising lines of copy.

motion.name: ease-smooth
motion.purpose: Rises, pans, the lozenge and the lift.

motion.name: ease-sharp
motion.purpose: Press, colour changes, the arrow nudge.

breakpoints.name: sm
breakpoints.purpose: Gutters to 32px; a row gains its thumbnail column and kind of client.

breakpoints.name: lg
breakpoints.purpose: The floating glass panel replaces the bar; the page takes 17.5rem on the left; the land centres on the column.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one primary action per view: an ember pill with on-ember text.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 46px; padding: 10px 24px; border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: var(--font-sans), Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 600; transition: transform var(--dur-fast) var(--ease-sharp); background: oklch(var(--trail)); color: oklch(var(--on-trail)); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 oklch(1 0 0 / 0.35); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px) scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(var(--trail)); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: The second path beside the primary: a clear glass pill.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 46px; padding: 10px 24px; border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: var(--font-sans), Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 600; transition: transform var(--dur-fast) var(--ease-sharp); background: oklch(var(--panel) / 0.7); backdrop-filter: blur(10px) saturate(1.5); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px oklch(var(--line-strong)), inset 0 1px 0 oklch(var(--shine) / var(--shine-a)); color: oklch(var(--ink)); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(var(--trail)); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Glass Panel
components.description: The floating panel: panel paper at 62% over a blurred, saturated backdrop, a specular top edge and the overlay shadow; the current page behind a lozenge.
components.html: Christian RaroWorkServicesAboutHire
components.css: .ds-panel { display: grid; gap: 2px; width: 256px; padding: 16px; border-radius: 26px; background: oklch(var(--panel) / 0.62); backdrop-filter: blur(22px) saturate(1.7); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px oklch(var(--line-strong) / 0.55), inset 0 1px 0 oklch(var(--shine) / var(--shine-a)), var(--shadow-overlay); font-family: var(--font-sans), Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-panel-name { padding: 0 12px 12px; font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 600; color: oklch(var(--ink)); } .ds-panel a { display: flex; align-items: center; height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 12px; font-weight: 500; color: oklch(var(--muted-strong)); text-decoration: none; } .ds-panel a:hover { color: oklch(var(--ink)); } .ds-panel a[aria-current=page] { color: oklch(var(--ink)); background: oklch(var(--ink) / 0.07); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 oklch(var(--shine) / var(--shine-a)); }

components.name: Project Row
components.description: A project as one link: thumbnail, name with status, one line. Hover slides a pane of glass under it.
components.html: BeachBus Palawan LiveShuttle booking and payments in El Nido
components.css: .ds-row { position: relative; isolation: isolate; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 8rem 1fr; align-items: center; gap: 20px; width: 520px; padding-block: 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid oklch(var(--line)); color: oklch(var(--ink)); text-decoration: none; font-family: var(--font-sans), Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-row::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 4px -14px; z-index: -1; border-radius: 14px; background: oklch(var(--ink) / 0.06); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 oklch(var(--shine) / var(--shine-a)); opacity: 0; } .ds-row:hover::before { opacity: 1; } .ds-row-shot { aspect-ratio: 8 / 5; border-radius: 10px; background: oklch(var(--panel)); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px oklch(var(--line-strong) / 0.6); } .ds-row-name { font-size: 1.0625rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.008em; } .ds-row-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; margin-left: 12px; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; color: oklch(var(--muted)); } .ds-row-status i { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 9999px; background: oklch(var(--live)); } .ds-row-line { display: block; margin-top: 4px; color: oklch(var(--muted-strong)); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Plan-the-route fields: ground at 70%, a field-border edge at 3:1, ink on focus.
components.css: .ds-field { display: block; width: 280px; font-family: var(--font-sans), Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-field span { display: block; margin-bottom: 6px; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: oklch(var(--muted-strong)); } .ds-field input { width: 100%; padding: 10px 14px; border: 1px solid oklch(var(--field-border)); border-radius: 10px; background: oklch(var(--bg) / 0.7); color: oklch(var(--ink)); caret-color: oklch(var(--trail)); font: inherit; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { border-color: oklch(var(--ink)); outline: 2px solid oklch(var(--trail)); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Status as glyph plus label, never colour alone: live dot, in-development ring, internal square.
components.html: Live In development Internal
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; margin-right: 12px; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; color: oklch(var(--muted)); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-status i { display: inline-block; width: 8px; height: 8px; } .ds-live { border-radius: 9999px; background: oklch(var(--live)); } .ds-dev { border-radius: 9999px; border: 1.5px solid oklch(var(--status-early)); } .ds-internal { border-radius: 1px; background: oklch(var(--status-internal)); }

components.name: Trail Link
components.description: The one text-link idiom: button-label type, an underline drawn from the left, an arrow that slides.
components.css: .ds-trail-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; color: oklch(var(--ink)); font-family: var(--font-sans), Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; } .ds-trail-link span { background: linear-gradient(currentColor, currentColor) left bottom / 0 1px no-repeat; transition: background-size var(--dur-fast) var(--ease-smooth); } .ds-trail-link:hover span, .ds-trail-link:focus-visible span { background-size: 100% 1px; }

narrative.overview:
The land is Mount Isarog over the Naga plain, drawn in 4px squares and fixed
behind every page. The page is one reading column of compact rows beside a
floating panel of glass. As you scroll, first light rises behind the summit; at
the foot of a page the dawn stands full. It is the one thing on the page that
follows the scroll, and it is the whole of the site's atmosphere.

The structure is borrowed from marwieang.com: a floating side panel, one
reading column, compact rows, a fixed dithered land. Everything that fills it
is Christian's own: Isarog and the Naga plain, a dawn the colour of a Bicol
morning, fireflies (alitaptap) over the near ground, and a glass made for this
palette.

**Night is the default.** The site opens in the hour before dawn: blue-black
sky, a dark land, ember on the summit's edge. The morning theme (`:root`) is the
same sheet after sunrise: pale cool paper, a peach dawn, a lit ridge. Both are
first-class; `ThemeProvider` starts at night and ignores the system setting, and
the panel's switch toggles them.

**Liquid glass, translated for the web.** Apple's liquid glass is a material
that bends light. On the web it is four things, kept honest: a blur with
saturation of what lies behind it, a specular edge (a 1px light line along the
top), a highlight that follows the pointer across the panel, and a lozenge of
glass that glides between links. Glass floats over the land and never over
other glass. It goes opaque for anyone who asks for less transparency or more
contrast, and where the browser has no `backdrop-filter`.

Motion is CSS plus the installed `motion` library, with no animation framework
beyond that. Three verbs: **rise** (copy and rows lift into place), **pan** (the
`/projects` map and the page glide to a waypoint) and **light** (the dawn climbs
as the page scrolls). Outside their gates nothing is offset and the server HTML
is the finished page.
keyCharacteristics: A pixel land behind everything, the only element that follows the scroll.
One column (49rem) beside a 16rem glass panel; compact rows, not cards.
Glass as the one material for what floats, and a flat paper for what is read.
Ember (`--trail`) for the primary action and the current position, and nothing else.
One typeface, Instrument Sans, in weights only.
Night by default; morning one switch away.

rules.name: The One Ember Rule
rules.body: Ember marks the primary action and the current position only. It never fills a large area, colours a heading, a hover or a link, or decorates. If it is not "do this" or "you are here", it is ink. (The dawn on the land is a different token, `--dawn`, and sits behind the page, never in it.)

rules.name: The Green Means Live Rule
rules.body: Green is a live system's status dot and nothing else; the chat assistant's dot is ink.

rules.name: The Ink States Rule
rules.body: Hover borders, field focus borders, `accent-color` and `::selection` are ink (selection: ink ground, page-colour text). The keyboard's focus ring and the caret are ember, because that is where you are.

rules.name: The Scrim Rule
rules.body: No word sits on the bare land. Under the reading column a scrim (the ground at 60%, 74% on a phone) keeps every word on near-flat colour while the land keeps its shape beside it.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Instrument Sans only. No serif, no mono, no second sans. The link-preview cards cannot read a variable font, so they use a static Recursive Sans file; that is the one exception and it lives off-page (`app/og/`).

rules.name: The Never-Glass-On-Glass Rule
rules.body: A surface on glass is a control (`.glass-control`, `.chip`, `.lozenge`) with no blur, or opaque paper (the phone menu). Two blurs never stack.

rules.name: The Opaque Fall-Back Rule
rules.body: Under `prefers-reduced-transparency: reduce`, `prefers-contrast: more`, or without `backdrop-filter`, `.glass` becomes solid panel paper with no blur. The land stays behind it; nothing changes meaning.

rules.name: The Flat-In-Flow Rule
rules.body: Nothing in the column's flow carries a shadow at rest. The glass floats; the rows lie flat.

dos: **Do** spend ember only on the primary action and the current position: the primary button, the send button, the current page or key, the focus ring and the caret.
**Do** put glass only on what floats over the land, and give it a fall-back: opaque under reduced transparency, more contrast and no `backdrop-filter`.
**Do** keep a scrim between the land and every word.
**Do** draw each list as rows on one hairline rhythm, with one link per row.
**Do** keep status to `StatusBadge`: a glyph and a label, never colour alone.
**Do** keep every width, weight and tracking in the type utilities in `globals.css`, and one family.
**Do** keep screenshots as stills in one frame ratio, and print the reason where there is none to show.
**Do** make a motion's gates explicit (`prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference`, `@supports` for scroll timelines, a fine pointer for hover) so the server HTML is the finished page.
donts: **Don't** put glass on glass, or a blur on a control that sits on glass.
**Don't** use ember for a hover, a heading, a link, a decoration or a large fill.
**Don't** use gradients as decoration. The two that exist do work: the panel's pointer highlight and the mask that fades a banner's screenshot into its glass.
**Don't** put a shadow on anything at rest in the column, or animate a `box-shadow`.
**Don't** put an eyebrow over a section heading.
**Don't** build a hero-metric template or a grid of identical cards.
**Don't** fake a screenshot for an auth-gated or internal project.
**Don't** pin a place a project's own words do not name.
**Don't** claim products of Christian's own: the work is client work and Online Creative Solutions projects, and the copy says whose.
**Don't** let anything but the dawn follow the page's scroll, or any motion run for more than five seconds.
